section_summary.extract_value: This introduction section describes a study conducted in Saudi Arabia examining body appreciation (BA), weight status, and weight loss efforts among middle-aged women (ages 45-65 years). The study aims to identify BA levels in this population and test whether BA mediates the relationship between BMI and weight loss efforts. The section provides background on the high prevalence of obesity in Saudi Arabia and notes that previous research has focused on college-age females rather than middle-aged women.
